_schema: mchatai-source/verbs/ios/_evals/goals.json — the goal set for the on-device agent evals (Phase AV.7). `expect` = verbs that must have succeeded; `mustRun` = what the engine nudges for, per goal; `forbid` = verbs that must NOT have run (scored on the Mac from the report); `source` = searched first. goals.goal: Find a paper about running local large language models on iOS, write it up as a document in AI Write, and turn that write-up into a short podcast episode.
Find a paper about on-device speech recognition on phones and write it up in AI Write.
Which recent paper on small language models for mobile devices would you pick, and why? Do not make a document or a podcast.
Search PubMed for studies on sleep and memory in older adults, read the best one and write it up in AI Write.
Search OpenAlex for work on coral reef restoration, read the best match and write it up in AI Write.
Search Hacker News for discussion of on-device language models and tell me which story looks most useful.
Read https://www.apple.com/newsroom/ and tell me the three main points.
Read the PDF at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.15285 and summarize its method in a few sentences.
Find a paper about battery life of on-device AI and make a short podcast about it. No document.
Use Semantic Scholar to find a paper about federated learning on phones and write it up in AI Write.
